newsitem.title: USA: CSX calls letter to shippers desperate act.
newsitem.headline: CSX calls letter to shippers desperate act.

text.p: CSX Corp said on Wednesday Norfolk Southern Corp's recently released letter to shippers about CSX's proposal to merge with Conrail Inc is an "act of desperation."
It pointed out Norfolk Southern set forth its position in this letter after ignoring CSX/Conrail offers to be involved in talks about the proposed transaction.
"We remain willing to meet with Norfolk Southern and explore our mutual interests with them, as we have indicated in the past," the CSX statement concluded.
The statement said: "Norfolk Southern's letter to shippers is a thinly disguised attempt to re-write more than 20 years of regulatory history in the United States.

"This act of desperation must reflect their own awareness that Norfolk Southern has been and continues to pursue a loser's strategy, solely intent on gaining or forcing competitive concessions from CSX/CRR.
"Moreover, this letter seems to be in disregard of the Surface Transportation Board's established process, with which we are fully prepared to comply.

"Shippers as well as employees and shareholders well know the fact that only after it became overwhelmingly apparent that Norfolk Southern's only interest was in consuming Conrail in its entirety, did Conrail and CSX commence discussions.

"The result of that effort was our proposed merger of equals, following which we immediately reached out to Norfolk Southern, seeking their involvement as the other major rail carrier in the region. They ignored those overtures, only to now set forth their position in a letter to shippers.
